<h2>Collect Unreadable Legacy sjSDM Cache Targets</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Collects prepared endpoints, errored targets, and named dependencies that
participate in a legacy 'qs' cache-read failure.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_legacy_cache_invalidation_targets(
  data_endpoints = NULL,
  data_target_errors = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_endpoints">data_endpoints</code></td>
<td>
<p>Prepared-endpoint diagnostics containing 'target_name', 'endpoint_status',
and 'error_message'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_target_errors">data_target_errors</code></td>
<td>
<p>Target metadata containing 'name' and 'error'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A unique character vector of targets to invalidate before retrying.
</p>

</main>
